name: git-kamaji
description: Lets Windows Git clients run all Git operations transparently inside WSL by translating commands and normalizing paths.

scripts.build: bun run build:git && bun run build:bash && bun run build:sh
scripts.build:git: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/git.exe && bun build src/app/entrypoints/git.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile ./dist/git.exe
scripts.build:bash: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/bash.exe && bun build src/app/entrypoints/bash.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile ./dist/bash.exe
scripts.build:sh: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/sh.exe && bun build src/app/entrypoints/sh.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile ./dist/sh.exe
scripts.build:e2e-mocks: bun build tests/e2e/mocks/git.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile ./dist/e2e-mock-git.exe && bun build tests/e2e/mocks/wsl.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile ./dist/e2e-mock-wsl.exe
scripts.test:local: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e:ci: bun run build && bun run build:e2e-mocks && bun test tests/e2e

author: Nelson R. Graña Vivas
